text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was wondering why Sakura Chiyono O
hadn't shown up for training—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry! I ended up being late!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I laid down to rest for a bit before training,
and before I knew it, I had fallen asleep...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I watched a scary video last night,
and it kept me from falling asleep for quite a while...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So, I started baking sweets to take my mind off things,
and got so absorbed that before I knew it, it was morning...
Honestly, that was the scariest part of all...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for the trouble caused by my carelessness.
I will be more careful from now on...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O seemed remorseful,
so I let the matter drop with just a light warning.
